method: Full reads of four pinned workflow definitions with Git blob/SHA256 verification. No CI execution/status inspected.
findings: Cygwin workflow builds and runs a small smoke fixture: rejects unequal pair and expects two duplicate_file CSV rows. It does not invoke pytest and ignores test-only source changes in trigger filters. Negative equal command treats any nonzero status as expected, including unrelated failures.

FreeBSD definition delegates prepare and build/test to scripts in a VM with cached preparation keyed through prepare-script SHA256 text. Delegated scripts remain unread, so actual test selection cannot be inferred from this workflow alone.

Multi-distro matrix is build-only: package installation and scons compilation in eleven container tags; no scanner correctness tests are invoked. It ignores test-only changes and permits Tumbleweed job failure. Moving image tags are not frozen runtime environments.

musl workflow delegates test behavior to Containerfile test target and starts privileged container, plus a separate GUI build target. Containerfile remains unread; definition alone does not prove suite selection or GUI runtime correctness.
